notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 88–638, § 3, Oct. 8, 1964, 78 Stat. 1038, authorized Commodity Credit Corporation to encourage export sales of extra long staple cotton which is in surplus supply at competitive world prices.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Pub. L. 90–475, § 8, Aug. 11, 1968, 82 Stat. 703, provided that the repeal of this section is effective Aug. 1, 1968.
